# Professional contour

Professional-audience products and journeys for doctors. Under `DEC-864`, the approved community direction is **RAIMOV Whole-Person Study Club** and the first educational product direction is **Whole-Person Treatment Planning Intensive**. Both are `NOT_LAUNCHED`; Raimov Academy remains a later, separately gated stage.

Professional routes, forms, consent, analytics and CRM must remain separate from patient acquisition.
